title: Pull Up Method

solutions.title: One billingAmountCents(), shared by both lesson types
solutions.tradeoff: Lesson gains a field and a method neither lesson type used to declare for itself, and a private lesson's materials fee and a group lesson's supplies fee now have to mean literally the same thing forever, not just today.

reviewFocus: Were PrivateLesson's materialsFeeCents and GroupLesson's suppliesFeeCents actually the same concept before the rename, or did renaming one to match the other paper over a real difference?

Does GroupLesson.billingAmountCents() charge a flat fee per lesson regardless of headcount, or does it secretly scale with the number of students - a difference the rename step alone would not have caught?
Is billingAmountCents() concrete on Lesson now, or did it stay abstract with two implementations underneath - the second is Pull Up Method in name only?
Was the fee field pulled up before the method, or did the method move first and reach for a field that did not exist yet on Lesson?

Compare against drill-12-04: this drill moves a method up because both subclasses need it identically; that one moves a method down because only one does. Does the walkthrough state the test that tells the two directions apart, or just assert the direction?
